title: The existing standard affine section counit theorem and its fixed-presentation square
statement: For N>0, finite commutative A with NA=0, normalized Tate transport t, and a specified family D of normalized projective-line data, let T be Noetherian with N invertible. For every d, there are normalized affine adjunctions over T and A1(T) whose raw section comparison restricts at one to the actual standard affine sectionMap, as defined in [def-trf-section-local-comparison-data], [def-trf-coordinate-counit-arrows] and [def-pur-noetherian-section-specialization-arrows]. This is the unchanged existing declaration sectionCoordinateCounit_standard, formerly in SectionCoordinateCounitNormalization. Consequently any two prescribed normalized adjunctions have the same affine dualizing isomorphisms as these witnesses. Their affineSectionIso maps satisfy i1*(oF), followed by inverse Tate pullback and the section compositor, equals standardFibreMap of [def-trf-section-coordinate-chart-maps] followed by oC.

proof.text: Use the ordered affine tower adjunction and its compact-support comparison. The normalized projective-line family has base change by uniqueness. Transpose pullback of its counit through exchange and use trace base change. Adjunction injectivity gives the standard exceptional comparison equation. Pull back to the zero section along i1 and insert the canonical Tate and section compositors. This is the original proof plan of sectionCoordinateCounit_standard, moved without changing its signature or proof obligation.

proof.text: Normalization equates the inverse affineDualizingIso maps with the same standardAdjoint. Iso.ext_inv therefore identifies the prescribed isomorphisms with the witnesses. Unfold affineSectionIso, restrictionAtOne and rawComparison. Compose on the right with the source orientation, use section-compositor naturality and cancel its inverse to obtain standardAffineSectionOrientation_one.

theorem sectionCoordinateCounit_standard (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA)
    (D : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T] (hT : IsUnit (N : Γ(T, ⊤))),
      OrdinaryFiniteP1Datum A N hA t T hT)
    (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S] (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤))) (d : ℕ) :
    ∃ (adjC : rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
        (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) S ↘ S) ⊣ affineRight A N hA S d)
      (adjF : rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
        (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) S) ↘ _) ⊣
          affineRight A N hA (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) S) d),
      CoordinateCounitArrows.IsNormalized N hN A hA t D S hS d adjC ∧
      @CoordinateCounitArrows.IsNormalized N hN A _ _ hA t D
        (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) S)
        (noetherianSource (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) S ↘ S))
        (invertibleOnSource N (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) S ↘ S) hS) d adjF ∧
      (restrictionAtOne A S
        (rawComparison A N hN hA S hS d _ _
          (affineSectionIso A N hN hA S hS d
            (AffineSpace.zeroSection (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) S) adjC)
          (@affineSectionIso A _ _ N hN hA (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) S)
            (noetherianSource (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) S ↘ S))
            (invertibleOnSource N (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) S ↘ S) hS) d
            (AffineSpace.zeroSection (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) _) adjF))).hom =
        sectionMap A
          (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) S) ↘ _)
          (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) S ↘ S)
          (AffineSpace.oneSection (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) S)
          (AffineSpace.map (ULift.{u} (Fin d))
            (AffineSpace.oneSection (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) S))
          (AffineSpace.isPullback_map _)
          (AffineSpace.zeroSection (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) _)
          (AffineSpace.zeroSection (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) S)
          (AffineSpace.zeroSection_comp_map _)
